name: Last to Leave the Circle
desc:
👍 NEW EVENT AT 170,000 LIKES!
Welcome to Last To Leave, players are flown out to a remote floating island where they compete to be the last one standing in a circle. Survive tons of different events and be the last one in the circle to win.

IF YOU HAVE ANY IDEAS, SUGGESTIONS, OR FOUND A BUG, PLEASE POST IT ON THE GROUP WALL!

Free UGC Limiteds, join the group to know when new ones drop!

NEW EVENTS:
Red Light Green Light
Mango Tree
Circus, 3008, Acid Rain, Toilet, Nextbots, Backrooms, Press the Button, Claw Machine

VIP Commands now in Private Servers! As the owner you can host your own last to leave games with the new commands.
